title: ReplayWorld
description: The loaded company world at one replay cursor (HAR-129 section 1, 2, 14). A computed read model: it is derived from the frozen DemoManifest and the stores, never persisted. Before Play the cursor is N-1 and the held-out event is withheld; after Play the cursor is N.

data_cutoff.description: Every event up to and including this time is materialized; later ones are not visible.

replay_position.description: Position of the last released event; 0 means none.

held_out_event_id.description: The event still withheld; null once it has been released.

current_state_refs.description: The current materialized state: the account roll-up and each opportunity state the case covers.

previous_deal_knowledge_boundary.description: Company knowledge may be learned only from deals that closed before this boundary; the current deal and ambiguous deals never feed it (HAR-130 previous/current split).

provenance_manifest_ref.description: The frozen manifest that lists the base-vs-synthetic provenance of every event, with its content hash.
